description: A dark blue long-sleeved knee-length wool tunic with restrained russet-and-cream geometric woven borders at the split neckline, cuffs and hem, over a cream linen shirt. A plain brown leather belt with a modest round metal buckle supports a small ordinary brown leather pouch. Loose brown trousers, grey-beige lower-leg wraps and brown soft leather ankle shoes complete the outfit. No headgear, armor or weapons.
